items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 17 at 6:02AM PDT until October 18 at 9:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...An increased risk for sneaker waves and strong rip
currents with breaking waves of 7 to 12 ft.

* WHERE...Pacific Coast beaches.

* WHEN...3 AM Saturday through 9 PM Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Waves can sweep across the shoreline without warning,
pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties, and rocks.
items.instruction:
Stay off of jetties, piers, rocks, and other waterside
infrastructure. Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf
and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. Monitor local weather,
surf and tide forecasts at www.weather.gov/mtr.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 18 at 8:25AM PDT until October 18 at 9:00PM PDT by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts up to 25 kt
expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Point Reyes to Pigeon Point
California out to 10 NM.

* WHEN...From 3 PM this afternoon to 9 PM PDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
